_approach: A halftime-to-doubletime build: the halftime trap backbeat (snare on beat 3 only) from the halftime groove accelerates to 8ths in bar 2, then to a full 16th snare roll ramping 60 to 127 as the kick thins to nothing, the classic trap/hyperpop half-time-into-roll trick that krushclub shares with dariacore-adjacent internet EDM. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
